policies.note: S3-FIFO admission: small probationary FIFO (~10% of capacity) with a frequency bit, main FIFO (~90%), and a keys-only ghost queue; single-touch scan keys never reach main
insertion-ordered FIFO baseline (the pre-admission policy); a hit does not reorder the queue, so a scan flushes the hot set
faithful LRU baseline; a hit promotes the key to most-recently-used and a miss evicts the least-recently-used key

note: Single-run, single-host hit-rate court over one identical scan-heavy key trace; only the eviction policy differs. This is a hit-RATE measurement, not a latency one: a higher hit rate is not a latency win. The reference court this reproduces measured admission 95.2% vs FIFO 88.0% vs LRU 95.2% on the same trace (capacity 32, 20-key hot set, 512-key scan). Admission matches LRU here because the hot set is re-referenced every scan step; the win is over the insertion-ordered FIFO, which the scan flushes.
